title: Master-detail page
summary: A list of records and the record the route selected. Wide, they sit side by side (a pk-list-page and the record pane); narrow, one shows at a time and the record has a Back button. The host owns the selection: set recordId from the route (a deep link works), and the element reports what the reader did through callback properties. load(query) feeds the list exactly as pk-list-page's does; open(row) is called when a row is chosen and close() when Back is pressed, so the host changes the route. mountDetail(pane, id) draws the record into the pane and returns a cleanup function or a { destroy() } handle, called when the record changes or the element leaves the page. While mountDetail is pending the built-in loading state shows over the record, a rejection shows the error state with Retry. Focus moves to the record once it is drawn, and back to the row that was open when the selection clears.

props.name: config
props.description: { list?, backLabel?, none?, label? }. list is pk-list-page's own config ({ columns, filters?, actions?, empty?, pageSize? }). backLabel is the Back button's text (default 'Back'). none is { heading?, description? } shown in the record pane while nothing is selected. label names the loading state. Optional title bar from the shared page shell: heading?: string, breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant?, hint? }] (a hint shows as a tooltip on the button) (an action without href fires pk-action). Nothing is drawn when none is set.

props.name: recordId
props.description: The id of the selected record, from the route; empty when none is. Untrusted text: it is only passed to mountDetail.

props.name: fill
props.description: Take all the room a flex column parent leaves.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of them.

parts.name: detail
parts.description: The record pane (focused once its record is drawn).

parts.name: back
parts.description: The Back button; shown only when one pane shows at a time.

parts.name: record
parts.description: The record's content; mountDetail draws into it.

parts.name: state
parts.description: Shows the loading or error state in place of the record.

a11y: The list keeps pk-list-page's table, filter and pagination semantics. The record pane is focusable and takes focus when a record opens, so a keyboard or screen reader user lands on it; Back returns focus to the row that was open. The loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's own roles.

examples.title: Things and their record (set config, load and mountDetail from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP, so wire it the way pk-list-page's load is wired)
